newsitem.title: UK: UK cash grains edge lower, hint of farm selling - May 14.
newsitem.headline: UK cash grains edge lower, hint of farm selling - May 14.

text.p: UK cash grains prices edged lower on Wednesday with brokers hinting at some farm selling.
"We think farmers are beginning to sell, but there are suggestions that some people are selling the market down in the hope of tempting the farmers out in a few days time," said one broker.
Values were around one to 1.50 stg down from Tuesday.
On the fob market the recent steady flow of business continued with Jun feed wheat fetching 92.75 and 92.50 stg, Oct/Dec 96.50 stg and Jan/Mar 98.50 stg a tonne.
Milling wheat 11 percent protein on the delivered market fetched 112 stg for May and 113.50 stg for Jun.
In East Anglia feed wheat traded at 92 and 91.50 stg while Oct/Dec fetched 97.50 stg.
In the west of England 91.50 stg was paid for May and 95 and 94.50 stg for Jul.
Only one trade was reported in feed barley when May fetched 92 stg in Norfolk/Suffolk.
